trust_decision.summary: A notification provider's server URL, set by the logged-in admin, is passed to a trailing-slash-stripping regex whose cost must stay linear in input length; the decision is made separately inside each provider's send().

landing_point.why: The advisory title names the pushdeer and whapi provider files; pushdeer is named first.

fix_sites.entry_point: socket.io 'testNotification' (server/server.js:1461) and monitor heartbeat notifications (server/model/monitor.js:1343) via Notification.send (server/notification.js:180-182)
socket.io 'testNotification' (server/server.js:1461) and monitor heartbeat notifications (server/model/monitor.js:1343) via Notification.send (server/notification.js:180-182)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Home Assistant is not named in the advisory (which lists only pushdeer and whapi), and the URL can only be set by the authenticated admin.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Trailing slashes must still be stripped so a configured base URL like 'https://host/' yields 'https://host/message/push'; the default URL 'https://gate.whapi.cloud/' ends with a slash, so dropping the stripping or rejecting slashes would break the default.

O6_input_shapes: URL ending in one or more slashes (stripped)
long run of slashes followed by a non-slash character (the backtracking shape)
pushdeer URL with surrounding whitespace (trim() before the regex)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Home Assistant provider strips trailing slashes from the admin-set homeAssistantUrl with the same unanchored /\/*$/ idiom, reached by the same testNotification and heartbeat routes
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names only pushdeer and whapi; this is a different provider
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Sibling file in the same directory (server/notification-providers/); a grep for the idiom finds it immediately

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another provider (about 90 files in this directory) normalising its base URL with /\/+$/ or /\/*$/
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Self-hosted providers each build the endpoint URL by concatenation, and three already copy this idiom independently.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333): polynomial backtracking in an unanchored trailing-character regex

O10_build.toolchain: Node 18 or >= 20.4, npm; tests use node --test (package.json:30)
O10_build.project_tests: test/backend-test via 'npm run test-backend' (package.json:30); no notification-provider tests found under test/ at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change only the two named regexes (e.g. to a loop with endsWith('/')) and leave home-assistant.js:19 unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: The preceding commit 03beef80 fixed a separate ReDoS in parseDuration; this advisory does not cover it.
src/util.js:143 splits on /_(.*)/s; it is not a trailing-slash idiom and was not pursued.
unverified: Whether home-assistant.js:19 is still unfixed in the latest release (latest release not provided).
Repo size in MB was not measured.
Real-world exploitability: all routes need an authenticated admin session (checkLogin at server/server.js:1463).
